evidence.notes: Intransitive témoigner (to testify) and with de (témoigner de quelque chose), per the usage note; transitive in témoigner sa reconnaissance / témoigner que… (to show, bear witness).
Takes a direct object, as the usage note states: vaincre un adversaire, vaincre une peur (to defeat, overcome).
Transitive viser une cible (to aim at/target something) and intransitive viser à + infinitive or absolute viser juste, as the usage note indicates.
Intransitive voter (pour/contre) per the usage note and related expression, and transitive voter une loi (to pass a law by vote).
Takes a direct object: écosser des petits pois, des haricots (to shell peas/beans).
